# ise_system_certificate_deployment (Resource)

This resource can manage a System Certificate Deployment. It coordinates Admin and optional shared EAP certificate assignments across all listed ISE nodes, with the live primary administration node last. Omit a node's Admin inputs to leave its Admin role unmanaged. Set its eap flag only when explicitly managing EAP. Required CA trust must already be installed on every node; manage trusted certificates separately. The provider reuses its configured credentials and HTTPS transport for the explicitly supplied node IPs. Nodes must belong to the same deployment, use the same credentials, and have API Gateway enabled where certificates are changed. Admin certificate changes restart ISE services and a primary PAN change can trigger additional deployment-wide restarts. After a write the resource waits at least 60 seconds for Admin changes and requires three consecutive healthy checks, including the served HTTPS certificate and every node's API/deployment status. This is ordered recovery, not a zero-downtime guarantee. Private keys are write-only and require Terraform 1.11 or later. Increment private_keys_wo_version when the key map changes. Portal transfers require explicit admin_portal_group_tag opt-in; unrelated certificate roles are retained. Reads never export private keys. Destroy relinquishes management and retains installed certificates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ise_system_certificate_deployment" "example" {
  root_certificate_pem = file("root-ca.pem")
  nodes = [
    {
      hostname              = "primary.example.test"
      address               = "192.0.2.5"
      admin_certificate_pem = file("primary.pem")
      admin_ca_pem          = file("issuing-ca.pem")
      eap                   = false
    }
  ]
  private_keys_wo         = { "primary.example.test" = file("primary.key") }
  private_keys_wo_version = 1
  timeout_seconds         = 1800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `nodes` (Attributes List) All deployment nodes in Admin rollout order; the live primary PAN must be last. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `private_keys_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Private keys keyed by node FQDN, plus eap when managing EAP. Not retained in resource state. Prefer ephemeral inputs; storing keys elsewhere is outside this resource's control.
- `private_keys_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for private_keys_wo. Increment when the write-only key map changes; keys are never stored in state.
  - Range: `1`-`2147483647`
- `root_certificate_pem` (String) Root CA used to verify desired and installed certificates. Root and issuer CAs must already be trusted for Infrastructure on every node; this resource does not import or alter CA trust.

### Optional

- `eap_ca_pem` (String) EAP issuing CA chain. Required only when managing EAP.
- `eap_certificate_pem` (String) Shared EAP certificate. Required with eap_ca_pem when any node enables EAP management.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Cancellation-aware recovery timeout per operation, in seconds.
  - Range: `120`-`7200`
  - Default value: `1800`

### Read-Only

- `active_fingerprints` (Map of String) Observed SHA256 fingerprints keyed by node FQDN/admin or /eap.
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `in_sync` (Boolean) Whether live role assignments, certificate identities, managed CA trust and Admin TLS endpoints satisfy the desired configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Required:

- `address` (String) Explicit node IP address used for HTTPS requests.
- `eap` (Boolean) Explicitly manage the shared EAP certificate on this node.
- `hostname` (String) Fully qualified node hostname.

Optional:

- `admin_ca_pem` (String) Admin issuing CA chain. Supply together with admin_certificate_pem.
- `admin_certificate_pem` (String) Omit to leave this node's Admin certificate entirely unmanaged.
- `admin_portal_group_tag` (String) Explicitly transfer Portal with Admin while retaining this existing portal group tag. Omit to leave Portal unmanaged.
